HBM-NEXT-CMTP: the P-lane record compiler for the next HBM die (P = 4), on the D1 compiler / price chain.

Fork, not edit: tools/hgi_sim (d4g compiler ds_mtp_verify / ds_mtp_draft / hbm_plane_model, the D1 model) is used
UNCHANGED; this module wraps its record compile (V.compile_verify, called by the verify, the DSpark draft bodies and the
SEED) with the P = 4 rules below, and runs the re-time.  Every rule is opt-in (Knobs); with every knob at the D1
value the wrapper is the identity, which the re-time checks against the D1 / STUDY records (validation rows).

P = 4 RULES (results/arch/hbm_next_1019/cmtp/isa_rows.md, HGI-1R):
  rpl   SM remainder pass (R5): an N-row SM record on P lanes costs max(1, issues / 1.374) of the AR record, issues =
        isa_rows.best_rpl(N, P, nc, rows per SM) (idle / K-split / row-split, the cheapest; D1: ceil(N / P)).  nc = the
        record's csum chunk count (K / 32 / 8 block-dot, K / 8 BF16), rows per SM = ceil(B.m / 16).
  union MoE union grouped GEMM: a union expert with c_u routed rows costs max(1, issues(c_u) / 1.374), averaged over the
        MEASURED lane histogram (MTP-STATS: verify N = 6 decorrelated estimate; users: independent mixed workloads);
        D1: the mean P_e = 6 N / U, ceil(ceil(P_e) / P).  Draft bodies (no histogram): P_e as D1, with rpl.
  m1    x-load beats + lane-major publish (D2 model gap M1): an SM record over N rows loads N x-slots (2,048-b xw beat:
        ceil(K esz / 256) beats a row) and publishes N result rows on the unchanged result port (8 FP32 words a beat a
        SM: ceil(rows per SM / 8) beats a row).  Charged EXPOSED (no overlap credit): (N - 1) x the x beats once per
        distinct x in a layer segment (the x-slot store keeps it for the other records) + (N - 1) x the publish beats
        on every SM record.  PRICED estimate, labelled.
  coll  COLL delivery lanes L (STUDY (a): L = 5 adopted, the widest the SerDes feeds; D1 4).
  hc    HC further-row II: MEASURED 250.0 (HBM-NEXT-UNITS tb_hnx_hc_eng4, hnx RTL root + 4 ring quarters, Verilator
        5.050, bit-exact N = 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8: HC_MIX 998 + 250 (N - 1); results/arch/hbm_next_1019/units/hc/README.md).
        It replaces both the priced HCP x6 II (250, D1) and the stale measured static-engine II (4,385, codex 128-lane
        engine the die does not bind) in the d4g row_ii; 600 / 950 kept as sensitivities only.
  vm    VM-resident N columns (D1 / VM grown) or as-built column swaps (STUDY (b)).

    PYTHONPATH=tools python3 tools/hbm_next/plane_compiler.py retime --out DIR [--jobs N]   (fleet: ~20-40 min)

meas_keys.idx_index: IDX.INDEX further row = c1 x 953 / 658.9 (UNITS-IDX units/idx/README.md: measured 953 a row of the 1,397-cycle d4g frame vs the priced 152 of 658.9; the key stream is re-read a row, selector top-512 binds); users: the same (no shared stream either way)
meas_keys.idx_index_abs: IDX.INDEX further row = 953 absolute (sensitivity: the measured row at the bench shape, not scaled to the record's c1)
meas_keys.idx_union: IDX.UNION record (the expert_union record, priced as a TOPK c1) = measured cycles(N) 48 / 67 / 90 / 101 / 142 at N = 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 6 (UNITS-IDX union; N = 5 interpolated)
meas_keys.su_vop: SU.VOP N-row (the un-indexed 'shared' SU records: norms, gates, residual ops) further row = (2k + 1) ceil(e / 512) + 2, k = per-row VM read operands (operands some record writes; constants broadcast), e = A elements a row (UNITS-SUDMA su_vop: AB 44 / ABC 72 at n 7,168, single store write port); the indexed route gather stays at its measured II 1 (= price)
meas_keys.kvwb: DMA.KVWB_DS further row 8 (+28 a ring wrap, amortised (N - 1) / 256 a record) (UNITS-SUDMA kvwb; priced 2)
meas_keys.coll_rg: COLL.ROW_GATHER further row = priced II x 623 / 1,449 (UNITS-COLL rows: measured II = R = 623 flits a rail at the DS verify shape where the model priced 1,449; payload-proportional for the other shapes)
meas_keys.att4: ATT PV row records: shared 4-lane merge PV span -40 cycles a pass (ATT4 a1: shared 385 / 529 / 745 / 1,089 vs base 401 / 569 / 785 / 1,129 at sigma 0 / 0.3 / 1 / disjoint; -40 at every overlap but full)
meas_keys.sm4skew: SM4 lane-major publish skew: +8 cycles a further lane a pass on every N-row SM.MATVEC record (hnx_rp4lp4 LSKEW 8; +24 a 4-lane pass); union experts by the measured lane histogram (1-lane experts: 0)
meas_keys.idxn: IDX.INDEX further row = c1 x 232 / 658.9 (UNITS-IDXN units/idxn/README.md: key pass once a record, K = 8 row streams, 4 time-shared selectors; MEASURED 1,297 + 232 (N - 1), bit-exact N = 1..6; replaces idx_index)
meas_keys.idx_frame: IDX.INDEX first row c1 x 1,297 / 658.9 on EVERY record incl. AR (IDXN measured frame; the d4g frame the release AR model prices at 658.9 measures 1,397) -- frame sensitivity, moves AR
meas_keys.su_vop2: SU.VOP N-row further row = 2 k ceil(e / 512) (k >= 1; k = 0: ceil(e / 512)) (UNITS-SUDMA2 units/sudma2: write-port split, AB 28 / ABC 56 at e = 7,168; replaces su_vop)
meas_keys.argmax2: ARGMAX.LOCAL further row 22 (UNITS-SUDMA2 wide ARGMAX ot_hnx_argmax_wide_rows; replaces argmax 169)
meas_keys.fused: FUSED.HC_PRE_NORM further row 81 (priced 160) and FUSED.HC_POST 103 (priced 100), KX = 4, rgap 0 (UNITS-FUSED units/fused/README.md, bit-exact N = 1/2/3/4/6)
meas_keys.fused_frame: FUSED.HC_PRE_NORM / HC_POST first row = MEASURED c1 404 / 196 (absolute, D 5,120) on every record incl. AR -- frame sensitivity, moves AR
